messages:
auditor_jane: Hi team — as part of the SOC 2 scoping, can you confirm which service accounts can decrypt customer data with KMS keys and where the audit logs live? Need a mapping + proof for the auditor. Scope: hosted API + Dedicated. Also need retention windows and how we show key policy changes.

maria.chen: Hi Jane. Quick summary: two KMS families — `prod-root` (master) and per-customer DEKs (alias `customer-dek-*`). Hosted API: DEKs generated per-tenant and wrapped by `prod-root`. Dedicated: customers may BYOK; we only store alias references.

tim.baxter: Adding service accounts that can call KMS: `infra-kms-sa` (rotation), `runtime-kms-sa` (runtime unwrap), `ops-kms-sa` (emergency ops). No user accounts have direct decrypt permissions.

arjun: Logs: CloudAudit/CloudTrail events are ingested to Splunk index `kms-audit`. Retention: 365 days on Splunk by default; we snapshot daily to `s3://redwood-audit/kms-snapshots/` for longer-term archive. Example query: `index=kms-audit resource=projects/*/cryptoKeys user=infra-kms-sa action=decrypt`.

auditor_jane: Thanks. For evidence we need: (1) a mapping doc that ties service accounts -> key aliases; (2) sample logs for the last 90 days showing `decrypt`/`encrypt` ops by `infra-kms-sa`; (3) a screenshot or export of the `prod-root` key policy showing permissions; (4) proof of last rotation (runbook output). Can you provide these by EOD Friday?

priya.nair: @maria.chen @arjun I can package the mapping CSV + 90-day log sample. For the key policy screenshot we need a console capture — will coordinate with ops. @tim.baxter do you have the rotation run ID and artifacts?

tim.baxter: Rotation run ID: `rot-2026-11-03-07`. I will attach the playbook execution log (includes pre/post key version fingerprints and KMS operation hashes). Also note: for BYOKs we have separate HSM audit chains; will include notes.

maria.chen: FYI we redact customer PII in exported logs. For auditor evidence we can provide a redacted trace and a synthetic tenant trace that demonstrates the flow. Mapping CSV columns: `service_account, permission, key_alias, scope, last_rotation`.

sec-bot: Automated note: Evidence export job queued (job_id: evidence-218888-01). ETA ~2h. Artifact will be posted to the thread when ready.

auditor_jane: Perfect. One more ask — do you have a control mapping to SOC 2 CC6.1 and ISO A.10/A.6.2 (key management, cryptographic controls)? Need a table mapping our controls to auditor controls.

arjun: Yes — mapping lives in Confluence: `/spaces/SEC/pages/Key+Mgmt+Control+Mapping`. I'll include a PDF snapshot in the export.

priya.nair: I'll coordinate packaging and deliverables: mapping CSV, 90-day redacted logs, rotation playbook log, key-policy export, and control-mapping PDF. ETA Friday 17:00 PST.

auditor_jane: Great — thanks all :thumbsup:
